answers.answer: Acknowledged and integrated; no verdict flips, but evidence_against changes on six names. (1) CXMT: withdrawal of the AMAT/TER/ASML mapping matches my round-3 mechanism read, so I remove it from the against-side and keep it only as a resolved note; the TRIM trigger it fed is not thesis evidence. (2) Summit: I had it on the against-side as a two-sided event, never as upside, so AMAT's strengthening did not lean on positive convexity. I restate it for AMAT, KLAC and ASML as no-change-to-tighter with the MATCH Act servicing-ban tail (AMAT China is 28% of revenue, secondary), and for TSM and QCOM as AI-chip-control direction. (3) TER is removed from the summit item and its CXMT item, leaving the memory-test residual (~16% of revenue) and the unverified Q3 sequential-decline hint; the array stays non-empty. (4) AMAT stays STRENGTHENING because the call rests on the reported Q3 FY26 quarter and the Q4 guide above the Street, DRAM +52% y/y and the ~80% leading-edge/DRAM/packaging WFE share, not on the summit or on CXMT. I am recording the honest caveat that with both props gone it is carried by a 5-week-old print and a -1.4 sigma laggard price: without fresh positive evidence by the next print INTACT is the fair default, and any SME-control tightening or MATCH Act progress on 09-24 moves it to WATCH. KLAC gets the same caveat. I did not downgrade today because nothing new and adverse exists; the summit is a dated unknown, not a finding.
